lead_story.topic: Yankees sweep Red Sox, White Sox sweep Astros, Phillies force Game 3
lead_story.headline: Wild Card Wednesday: Yankees and White Sox sweep to ALDS, Phillies survive

tweets.text:
FINAL: Yankees 9, Red Sox 2

New York sweeps Boston in dominant fashion and heads to the division series against top-seeded Tampa Bay. Every starter registered a hit. Cody Bellinger socked a three-run home run. The Yankees did just about everything well. The Red Sox … did not.

FINAL: White Sox 7, Astros 3

One day after receiving a letter from Pope Leo XIV offering "abundant blessings," the Chicago White Sox have won a playoff series for the first time in more than two decades. They went to Houston and absolutely ran the Astros. Cleveland awaits next.

lead_story.research_notes: CONTINUING [Day 3 for Yankees-Red Sox, Day 3 for White Sox-Astros, Day 3 for Phillies-Braves]: Three Wild Card series games decided today. Yankees SWEEP Boston 9-2 after obliterating them 9-0 yesterday — Cody Bellinger's 3-run HR in 5th blew it open per JomboyMedia/ESPN, Luis Garcia Jr. first career postseason homer put Yankees on board first per SportsCenter. Yankees outscored Red Sox 17-1 across two games per JeffPassan. Boston has not scored a run in their last 26 postseason innings per JeffPassan, dating back to Game 2 of 2025 wild card series — hitting .136/.183/.148 with one extra-base hit in 88 at-bats in that span per JeffPassan. Yankees now face top-seeded Tampa Bay Rays in ALDS. White Sox SWEEP Astros 7-3 — Gavin Sheets pinch-hit 2-run homer per JomboyMedia/ClutchPoints. Chicago's first playoff series win since 2005 World Series per SportsCenter, one day after receiving letter from Pope Leo XIV offering 'abundant blessings' per SportsCenter. White Sox advance to face Cleveland — first time division rivals meet in playoffs per SportsCenter. Phillies SURVIVE after Braves led 3-1 in 8th — Kyle Schwarber and Bryce Harper back-to-back HRs tied it per JomboyMedia/ESPN, Alec Bohm go-ahead HR in 10th per JomboyMedia/ClutchPoints. Andrew Painter threw 3 scoreless innings per JeffPassan. JT Realmuto sealed it with walk-off ABS challenge per CespedesBBQ. Only series not to end in sweep — Game 3 Thursday. Research angles: (1) Red Sox offensive collapse historic — 26 innings without a run is a staggering futility, compare to other postseason shutout streaks; (2) White Sox Pope letter is one of the weirdest sports stories of the year — did the Pope actually send it? When? Why? Thread that into the 21-year drought narrative; (3) Phillies' back-to-back HRs were their first real moment of offense in the series — how rare is it for a team to be two outs from elimination and then hit consecutive bombs to tie it? (4) Padres also completed sweep today (covered in supporting) — this is the year of the sweep except for Philly-ATL drama.

supporting_stories.headline: Mike Tomlin unveils Minecraft city he's been building for 12 years

tweets.text: Mike Tomlin built a CVS in Minecraft

I consulted my 11-year-old son on how long it would take to create the Minecraft scene that @CoachTomlin built. He said, "Two years, eight hours a day." He then knocked it down to one year, eight hours a day.

supporting_stories.research_notes: Tomlin revealed Minecraft world he's built over 12 years per SleeperHQ/ghetto_gronk/NFLMemes — includes CVS, 30-story luxury high rise with lap pool, indoor/outdoor restaurant, wellness center per AlbertBreer/ghetto_gronk. AlbertBreer's 11-year-old son estimates 'two years, eight hours a day' to create, then knocked it down to one year per AlbertBreer. BillBarnwell: 'Mike Tomlin built a CVS in Minecraft.' SleeperHQ: 'Steelers fans realizing they've only won 3 playoff games since this Minecraft world was created…' NFLMemes: 'I would rate it a 9-8 out of 10 🔥' (Steelers' record joke). SharpFootball splits: Tomlin before Minecraft (7 seasons): 1 Super Bowl win, 2 Super Bowl trips, 5 playoff wins (5-3, 0.625). Tomlin with Minecraft (12 seasons): 0 Super Bowl wins, 0 Super Bowl trips, 3 playoff wins (3-9, 0.250). Research angles: (1) This is one of the funniest sports stories of the year — a Hall of Fame coach spent 12 years building a Minecraft city complete with a CVS, and the internet's reaction is to roast the Steelers' playoff futility; (2) The splits are devastating: Tomlin won a Super Bowl before Minecraft, then won 3 playoff games in 12 years after starting it; (3) The 'things you can do when you never have a losing season but also never win playoff games' angle — Tomlin is 9-8 every year, has time to build cities; (4) Cross-reference Tomlin's 'Browns is the Browns' quote from yesterday's story log (Sept 21) — Monken fired back, Steelers lost, Tomlin went home and built a CVS.
supporting_stories.gif_concept: Quiet resignation as the Steelers' playoff failures pile up — Steelers fans watching Tomlin give a Minecraft tour while their team hasn't won a playoff game in years

beats.angle: Tomlin unveils 12-year Minecraft city complete with CVS, luxury high rise, lap pool, restaurant — '9-8 out of 10'
beats.landing: This is genuinely one of the funniest sports stories of the year; Tomlin's dedication to Minecraft is as consistent as his regular-season mediocrity

supporting_stories.topic: Steelers trade Joey Porter Jr. to Cowboys
supporting_stories.headline: Steelers trade Joey Porter Jr. to Cowboys for 2028 2nd-rounder — contract standoff ends

tweets.text:
After a lengthy and contentious contract standoff and a lingering back issue, Pittsburgh Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr. is going to the Dallas Cowboys.

⬇️⬇️

When the Steelers listed “conditioning” and “not injury-related” along with the back issue that Joey Porter Jr. reported as part of his injury-report designation, this thing was probably over. That’s essentially publicly calling the player on it.

Obviously, money is at the root of the trade. But having a contract dispute and needing to trade a good player away off a team built to win right now are two different things. Pittsburgh went from the first place to the second place with Porter, and here we are.

supporting_stories.research_notes: Pittsburgh traded Porter to Dallas for 2028 2nd-round pick and 2027 6th-rounder per AdamSchefter/TomPelissero. Porter listed 'conditioning/not injury-related' with back issue per AlbertBreer — team publicly called him on it per AlbertBreer. No new contract for Porter per AlbertBreer. Cowboys now have four defensive starters acquired via trade since August: Kenny Clark, Quinnen Williams, Rashan Gary, Porter per AlbertBreer — traded away Micah Parsons and Osa Odifhizuwa per AlbertBreer. 'That's a very aggressive rebuild' per AlbertBreer. Cowboys get Porter without extension, will now have to pay up per CBS Sports. Research angles: (1) Porter's contract standoff with Steelers ended badly — team publicly listed him as 'conditioning/back/not injury-related,' which is essentially calling the player on it per AlbertBreer; (2) Cowboys aggressive trade strategy: four defensive starters via trade, two (Porter and George Pickens) want lucrative extensions from same agent (David Mulugheta, Micah Parsons' agent) per AdamSchefter; (3) Steelers went from 'contract dispute' to 'needing to trade a good player off a team built to win right now' per AlbertBreer — that's a massive organizational failure; (4) Jerry Jones hinted at training camp he'd give up draft capital per AdamSchefter, now he's done it twice (Pickens, Porter).
supporting_stories.gif_concept: Smug confidence after making a big move — Jerry Jones after trading for Joey Porter Jr., convinced this fixes the Cowboys' secondary

beats.landing: Pittsburgh's handling of this was a disaster; they went from contract dispute to trading a good player off a contender

beats.angle: Cowboys' aggressive rebuild: four defensive starters via trade since August, two (Porter and Pickens) want extensions from same agent
beats.landing: Dallas is all-in on the trade market, but now they owe extensions to two players repped by Micah Parsons' agent — Jerry's gamble
